classes/breachgnome-696.name: Seal the Breach
classes/breachgnome-696.description: Fight defensively in cramped terrain: gain +2 dodge AC while adjacent to a solid Medium-or-larger object, or +4 with solid objects on opposite sides. At 3rd level gain +4 on specified opportunity/stability checks against entering, bull rush and overrun; at 5th gain +4 on movement opportunity attacks and increase Tumble DCs through your square or threatened area by 10.

classes/breachgnome-696.name: Uncanny Dodge
classes/breachgnome-696.description: At 2nd level retain Dexterity to AC when flat-footed or against invisible attackers. At 5th level you can no longer be flanked except by a rogue at least four levels higher. Levels from other uncanny-dodge classes stack for this progression.

classes/breachgnome-696.name: Bonus Feat
classes/breachgnome-696.description: At 2nd and 4th level select a bonus feat from the breachgnome list, meeting all prerequisites. Weapon-specific repeatable options may be selected again for a different weapon.

classes/dwarf-paragon-1001.name: Craft Expertise
classes/dwarf-paragon-1001.description: Add dwarf paragon class level as a racial bonus on Craft checks related to stone or metal items.

classes/dwarf-paragon-1001.name: Improved Stonecunning
classes/dwarf-paragon-1001.description: Increase the dwarf racial Search bonus for unusual stonework to +4, increase the automatic Search range to 20 feet, and intuit true north underground as though having 5 ranks in Survival.

classes/dwarf-paragon-1001.name: Improved Darkvision
classes/dwarf-paragon-1001.description: At 2nd level increase darkvision range by 30 feet.

classes/dwarf-paragon-1001.name: Save Bonus
classes/dwarf-paragon-1001.description: At 2nd level increase the dwarf racial save bonus against poison, spells, and spell-like effects by 1.

classes/dwarf-paragon-1001.name: Ability Boost
classes/dwarf-paragon-1001.description: At 3rd level Constitution permanently increases by 2 points.

classes/gray-hand-enforcer-302.name: Damage Reduction
classes/gray-hand-enforcer-302.description: Gain damage reduction 1/— at 1st level, 2/— at 3rd level, and 3/— at 5th level.

classes/gray-hand-enforcer-302.name: Gray Hand Token
classes/gray-hand-enforcer-302.description: Carry the Gray Hand token recognized by Waterdeep officials. Showing it grants +5 on Charisma-based skill checks against Waterdeep officers or officials and provides the source-described protection from arrest or hindrance.

classes/gray-hand-enforcer-302.name: Dragonward Strike
classes/gray-hand-enforcer-302.description: Within 10 miles of Waterdeep, either make a melee attack with +4 to hit and bonus damage equal to Gray Hand enforcer level, or empower a single spell without prior preparation or increasing its level. Use once per day at 2nd level and twice per day at 4th.

classes/gray-hand-enforcer-302.name: Spell Resistance
classes/gray-hand-enforcer-302.description: At 4th level gain spell resistance equal to 5 + character level.

classes/gray-hand-enforcer-302.name: Lords' Boon
classes/gray-hand-enforcer-302.description: At 5th level heal up to 20 hit points of your own wounds per day, all at once or divided among several uses.

classes/guardian-paramount-457.name: Bonus Feat
classes/guardian-paramount-457.description: At 1st level and every three levels thereafter choose a bonus feat from the guardian paramount epic list, meeting the feat's prerequisites.

classes/guardian-paramount-457.name: Uncanny Dodge Enabler
classes/guardian-paramount-457.description: Extend your existing uncanny dodge features to one designated creature within 5 feet. Change the designation as a free action once per round. Uses are 3/day at 1st level and increase at 4th, 7th, and 10th levels.

classes/guardian-paramount-457.name: Evasive Preceptor
classes/guardian-paramount-457.description: Extend your evasion or improved evasion to one designated creature within 5 feet. Uses are 1/day at 2nd, 2/day at 5th, and 3/day at 8th.

classes/guardian-paramount-457.name: Protective Aura
classes/guardian-paramount-457.description: Create a special shield other effect as an 8th-level cleric; transferred wounds are subdual damage. Use 1/day at 3rd, 2/day at 6th, and 3/day at 9th.

classes/guardian-paramount-457.name: Adjust Probability
classes/guardian-paramount-457.description: Force another visible creature within 25 feet to reroll an attack roll, check, or saving throw after the result is known; the second roll must be used. Use 2/day at 5th level and 3/day at 8th.

classes/guardian-paramount-457.name: Call Back
classes/guardian-paramount-457.description: Return to life a dead creature that previously received one of your other class abilities, as true resurrection cast by a 20th-level cleric. Use once per day through 10th level.

classes/legendary-dreadnought-459.name: Unstoppable
classes/legendary-dreadnought-459.description: Once per day at 1st level, and twice per day at 6th, gain +20 on a Strength check to break or burst an object, on the special Strength DC 32 check to break wall of force, or instead on a single attack roll.

classes/legendary-dreadnought-459.name: Unmovable
classes/legendary-dreadnought-459.description: Once per day at 2nd level, and twice per day at 7th, gain +20 on a qualifying grapple/Strength check against forced movement or on one saving throw. A movement effect that normally allows no save can instead permit a Will save with this bonus.

classes/legendary-dreadnought-459.name: Shrug off Punishment
classes/legendary-dreadnought-459.description: Gain 12 bonus hit points at 3rd level and another 12 every five levels thereafter; at 10th level the total class-granted bonus is 24 hit points.

classes/legendary-dreadnought-459.name: Thick Skinned
classes/legendary-dreadnought-459.description: Gain damage reduction 3/— at 4th level, improving by 3 every five levels thereafter; at 10th level this class grants DR 6/— subject to the source stacking limitations.

classes/legendary-dreadnought-459.name: Bonus Feat
classes/legendary-dreadnought-459.description: At 5th level and every five levels thereafter choose a bonus feat from the legendary dreadnought epic list, meeting all prerequisites.
